interface_status: Provisional handwritten interface; no compiler, runtime or browser execution claimed
label: EntryTile
prompt: Present the admitted code, title, barcode, summary, rank and archive evidence with canonical captions, exact formatting and withheld-field omission. Arrange only the declared canonical edit, archive, restore and delete controls. Keep notes, collection queries, paging and history at their caller; do not introduce a form implementation, mutation or independent lookup.

provisional_binding.input: admitted row and checked declared canonical controls

definition_style_prompt: Keep entry identity and barcode readable, wrap summaries naturally, and separate canonical actions with modest gaps. Inherit theme and preserve keyboard focus.
